_note: SPECULATIVE-DECODE VERIFY campaign (user 2026-09-27, follow-up #4). One MLA decoder layer, one B200 rank of the cookbook TP8/EP8 recipe. Points `B,L,vk<k>` = ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY: B requests at context L each verify k+1 tokens (k draft + bonus, chain / topk=1) in one forward, as EAGLE/MTP verification does. MLA takes the absorbed path: the TRT-LLM/CuteDSL decode kernel with q_len = k+1 per request over the L+k+1 fp8 latent-KV tokens (trtllm_mla_backend.forward_extend verify branch), writing the k+1 new KV rows. Primary: 64 requests x 4 tokens @8k; secondaries: 128 x 4 @8k and 16 x 4 @64k. Metric = eager step time (production graph-captures verify; this harness times both sides eagerly). Correctness = strict max-rel rule on all B*(k+1) output rows + post-step state. Oracle: the decode prediction at the same B/L (VibeSim has no verify branch; the verify step is ~ a decode step with k+1 query rows). GPU mode: slurm.
